scope: Decision-only theorem architecture using exact capped Davis-Putnam elimination plus v2 root macro restore and root-free fixed-depth v3 extension-tail descent.

lemma_1.statement: Let F be any canonical CNF with state_units s=1+m+L, where m is clause count and L is total literal occurrences. For any live pivot x, the raw exact existential-elimination output before canonical duplicate/subsumption cleanup has state_units <= s + mL <= s + (s-1)^2/4 < s^2 for s>=2. Therefore whenever s<=N and the frozen cap is N^2, every live pivot fits the exact elimination cap; in particular first_capped_elimination cannot fail on a nonterminal state of volume <=N.
proof: Partition pivot-containing clauses into p positive and q negative buckets plus r neutral clauses. Let Lp,Lq,Ln be their literal-occurrence sums.
There are at most pq raw resolvents. Their total literal occurrences after removing the pivot literals are at most q(Lp-p)+p(Lq-q).
Adding the pq clause-header units gives pq+q(Lp-p)+p(Lq-q)=qLp+pLq-pq <= qLp+pLq.
Neutral contribution is r+Ln. Hence raw state_units <=1+r+Ln+qLp+pLq <=1+m+L+mL=s+mL.
Since m+L=s-1, AM-GM gives mL<=(s-1)^2/4. Thus raw state_units<s^2 for s>=2.
Tautology rejection, duplicate removal, canonicalization and subsumption can only decrease this raw bound.
lemma_1.consequence: A terminal failure NO_CAPPED_CERTIFIED_MOVE is possible only after the retained representation has crossed the original-volume threshold state_units>N, unless an earlier exact terminal lane already decides the residual.

lemma_2.statement: For the frozen v2/v3 grammar, changing the historical extension cap from N to N^2 removes an artificial fail-closed boundary without creating an unbounded resource: the number of successful macro introductions over any run is at most 2n, where n is the number of original root variables and n<=N. Hence for N>=2 the N^2 cap cannot bind on any run before all structurally possible v2/v3 macro steps have already been consumed.
proof: A successful v2 macro is admitted only together with roots_only=True exact elimination of one currently live root variable. No transition can recreate a root identifier as a fresh extension. Therefore successful v2 macro count<=n.
v3 is syntactically guarded to run only when no root variable remains live.
At entry to the root-free tail, every live variable is an extension introduced by earlier v2 moves, so the live tail population is <=n.

Each successful v3 step introduces one fresh extension and then exactly eliminates two distinct variables that were live before the macro. Thus retained live-variable count drops by at least one per v3 step, giving successful v3 count<=n.
Therefore total successful extension introductions<=2n<=2N<=N^2 for every N>=2.
lemma_2.implementation_implication: A theorem-mode successor may freeze extension_exponent=2. This is a resource relaxation justified before any new totality result is observed; it preserves a fixed polynomial cap and makes historical-extension exhaustion unreachable by the grammar's own structural count.

corollaries.statement: Unit propagation and ordinary elimination strictly remove live variables; v2 adds one extension while eliminating one root so retained live count does not increase; v3 adds one and eliminates two so retained live count decreases. Thus retained live-variable count never exceeds the initial n<=N.

Across the whole decision run at most n v2 births and n v3 births occur. Nonmacro removal steps can remove only variables among the n initial plus at most 2n introduced variables. Therefore a coarse outer state-changing transition bound is O(N), independent of finite experiments.
Even retaining historical nonreused extension IDs, at most 2N successful macros imply maximum generated identifier O(N) after dense input normalization; identifier bit length remains O(log N).

remaining_totality_region.name: HIGH_VOLUME_RESCUE_REGION
remaining_totality_region.definition: Reachable nonterminal states with state_units>N for which no exact typed terminal lane decides immediately.
remaining_totality_region.reason: LOW_VOLUME_ELIMINATION_ALWAYS_FITS already proves a capped existential move below or at volume N.
open_sublemmas: ROOT_PHASE_HIGH_VOLUME_RESCUE: while roots remain and ordinary capped elimination fails, prove v2 exact macro restore exists or find a reachable counterexample.
ROOT_FREE_HIGH_VOLUME_RESCUE: after roots vanish and ordinary capped elimination fails, prove v3 fixed-depth descent exists or find a reachable counterexample.
